relations.subject: Jeffrey Moussaieff Masson
relations.evidence: In 1970, Masson began studying to become a psychoanalyst at the Toronto Psychoanalytic Institute, completing a full clinical training course in 1978.

relations.subject: Jeffrey Moussaieff Masson
relations.evidence: His training analyst was Irvine Schiffer, a well-known Toronto analyst and author of books on the unconscious aspects of charisma and time.
